description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling FIPS endpoint configuration. It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, INI files, and fallback logic, along with supporting methods for caching and combining multiple providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various static methods for creating configuration providers for AWS FIPS endpoints using environment variables, configuration files, or default fallback values.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from a specified INI file and profile.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback configuration provider based on the region, choosing FIPS or non-FIPS configuration.
